books.name: Idea Office Hours
books.description: Pressure-test a product idea with forcing questions before jumping to solutions, then capture the decision in a short design doc — a structured 'office hours' diagnostic.

books.name: Root-Cause Investigation
books.description: Debug systematically: reproduce the failure and find the true root cause before changing any code, then fix and verify. Enforces a no-fix-without-diagnosis discipline.

books.name: Technical Documentation
books.description: Generate a coherent documentation set from a codebase, organized by the Diataxis model (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation), with cross-links and a coverage pass.

books.name: Executive-Level Review
books.description: A strategic, executive-level review of a plan or scope: challenge the premise, weigh alternatives, and score each dimension before committing — the 'should we even build this' pass.

books.name: Spec Authoring
books.description: Turn a rough intent into a backlog-ready spec: interrogate scope and requirements against the real code, then file a well-formed, unambiguous issue.

books.name: Security Architecture Review
books.description: A structured security architecture review: walk the stack for secrets, dependencies, auth, and common vulnerability classes, then report findings ranked by severity and confidence.

books.name: Design System Consultation
books.description: Interview for product context and taste, then propose a full design system — type, color, layout, motion — and capture it as a DESIGN.md with live preview pages.

books.name: Browser QA Audit
books.description: Exercise a running app in a real browser, triage what breaks, and produce a report-only QA findings list with a health score — no code changes.

books.name: Engineering Retrospective
books.description: Build a data-grounded engineering retrospective from git history: activity, hotspots, review patterns, and per-person growth notes for a given window.
